per_organization_cutoffs: Identical split bounds for all five organizations; only the manifest-listed replay hours are scored, not continuous coverage of the entire calendar split
source_time: Timezone-naive microsecond timestamps; no conversion to the execution computer timezone
assignment: Reuse every frozen Phase 5 variant_id/split/seed/anchor/end_exclusive; no reshuffle, no combining alternative branches into one chronological stream

scoring.primary_unit: eligible local User-time at a fixed ten-minute grid snapshot (User-window)
scoring.asof: t=anchor+offset; consume entire tied timestamp batch at t before scoring; use only (t-7 days,t] history and (t-10 minutes,t] recent evidence
scoring.targets: All active local User nodes on the fixed grid; do not select Users using labels or campaign membership; masked Users can be scored but do not enter supervised loss or primary metrics
scoring.label_queries: Use exact grid_snapshot schedule rows at t; absent labels are context-only and masked; event/expiry rows are state transitions, not extra independent primary examples
scoring.last_interval: Frozen grid excludes the exclusive hour end. The last ten minutes have no endpoint primary grid score; report this coverage limitation. Continuous event-driven alerts are a separate later evaluation, never mixed into the grid FPR denominator.
scoring.primary_training_examples: Same fixed grid and eligibility as primary validation; history is graph context only. Future event/expiry labels never supervise earlier grid states. Sampling/weighting remains for Subphase 3 using TRAIN/VAL only.

warmup.source: Frozen per-block/per-organization history references; load [anchor-7 days,anchor), then runtime excludes the exact lower bound at scoring t
warmup.branch_state: Independent fork or fresh initialization per variant from shared observed background; never inherit synthetic events or labels from another variant
warmup.cross_split: Earlier observed raw background may be causal context inside seven-day retention even across a boundary; no synthetic infrastructure or fitted state from VAL/TEST may enter TRAIN
warmup.checkpoint: Reuse only matching organization, branch lineage and clock <= requested asof; representative endpoint checkpoints cannot initialize earlier training states

supervision.positive: Recent synthetic targeting evidence; not attacker identity or account compromise
supervision.negative: Clean-negative candidates only; source flags do not certify benignness
supervision.excluded: Ambiguous/masked, missing labels, context-only and every IP node excluded from loss and primary FPR denominator
supervision.timing: latest_positive_evidence <= label_time < positive_expires_at; evidence must be within the trailing ten minutes and strictly before the TRAIN end cutoff for training
supervision.reporting: Report fixed-grid prevalence separately from full sparse schedule counts; both are dependent observations

preprocessing.current: Accepted fixed log1p/count ratios only; no learned state
preprocessing.reuse: Persist any future learned encoder/scaler/imputer with organization, TRAIN cutoff, schema/hash and fit split; never refit on VAL or TEST

fpr.rationale: Predeclared research budget of at most one false-positive decision per 100 eligible negative User-windows. Chosen before model results; balances a restrictive low-FPR comparison with finite validation counts. It is not a deployment SLA or a per-day probability.
fpr.definition: FP / (FP+TN) on eligible y=0 fixed-grid User-time examples only
fpr.calibration: Local threshold for each organization and detector using VAL only; retain the repeated-branch validation denominator and disclose dependence; calibrator implementation is Subphase 5
fpr.ties_and_finite_samples: Select the most permissive threshold with empirical FP <= floor(0.01*N_negative); never split equal-score ties or exceed the budget. If no finite threshold qualifies use a no-alert threshold; if no eligible negatives calibration fails. Report realized FPR, N and resolution 1/N. Detailed executable calibration belongs to Subphase 5.
fpr.sensitivity: No additional operating points predeclared in v1; changes require a new protocol before TEST access

aggregation.primary: Per organization, plus equal-weight macro across the five organization metrics; report undefined metrics explicitly rather than dropping failed organizations
aggregation.secondary: Pooled eligible confusion counts across organizations; keep separate from macro
aggregation.breakdowns: Report split, campaign seed, organization and factor/family; distinguish training randomness from campaign seeds
aggregation.dependence: Alternative branches share background and three temporal blocks per split. Pooled counts are descriptive benchmark counts, not independent natural events. No naive IID confidence intervals over rows or branches; uncertainty requires predeclared temporal-block-aware analysis and remains limited by only three blocks.
aggregation.user_counts: Report graph User-node counts per grid, summed User-window exposures and distinct organization-local observed users; never deduplicate IDs across organizations

test_seal.allowed_in_subphase1: Read-only integrity, temporal/infrastructure audits and predeclared descriptive class counts; no predictions, scores, detector comparisons or data-driven protocol choices
test_seal.final_evaluation: Only after explicit protocol acceptance, version-control commit of the frozen protocol and later model/threshold locking; no authorization granted by this file

later_work: Sampler/input loader Subphase 2; model/training Subphase 3; comparator Subphase 4; calibration Subphase 5; continuous alerts Subphase 6; indicator comparator Subphase 7; campaign boundary/horizon Subphase 8. No such implementations here.
